blocks.text: MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash：两款全新的编码模型，专为日常企业编码任务打造，以竞品模型零头的成本带来领先的性能。

inlines.text: MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash：两款全新的编码模型，专为日常企业编码任务打造，以竞品模型零头的成本带来领先的性能。

blocks.text: 日常编码的性能与速度

inlines.text: 日常编码的性能与速度

blocks.text: MAI Code 2 在常见企业编码任务上处于性价比前沿，擅长将代码推向生产、深度调试、多文件实现、仓库级推理以及 UI。在完成这些工作的同时，它还能给出代码维护者愿意合并的改动，而成本仅为前沿模型的一小部分。

inlines.text: MAI Code 2 在常见企业编码任务上处于性价比前沿，擅长将代码推向生产、深度调试、多文件实现、仓库级推理以及 UI。在完成这些工作的同时，它还能给出代码维护者愿意合并的改动，而成本仅为前沿模型的一小部分。

blocks.text: 与此同时，MAI Code 2 Flash 面向高吞吐量的工作，例如代码解释、定向修改、常规修复和快速迭代，以低得多的成本带来出色的质量。

inlines.text: 与此同时，MAI Code 2 Flash 面向高吞吐量的工作，例如代码解释、定向修改、常规修复和快速迭代，以低得多的成本带来出色的质量。

blocks.text: 不到一半价格的生产级质量

inlines.text: 不到一半价格的生产级质量

blocks.text: 为了实现最佳性价比，我们在构建这些模型时优先考虑客户每天进行的编码工作。它们目前明确尚未针对更困难的问题进行调优，例如基础科学研究以及超长周期的智能体工作。

inlines.text: 为了实现最佳性价比，我们在构建这些模型时优先考虑客户每天进行的编码工作。它们目前明确尚未针对更困难的问题进行调优，例如基础科学研究以及超长周期的智能体工作。

blocks.text: 在四项广泛使用的基准测试（DeepSWE 1.1、Terminal Bench 2.1、SWE-Atlas 和 FrontierCode v1.1）上取平均，这些基准针对我们在 GitHub Copilot 中看到的日常企业编码任务，MAI Code 2 以 GPT 6.1 Sol 40% 的成本提供了其 98% 的性能，并以 Claude Opus 5.5 仅 5% 的成本提供了其 96% 的性能。1

blocks.text:
关于这些结果

结果反映的是在特定编码任务和配置下的评测。性能与成本对比会因工作负载、模型配置、推理强度以及定价假设的不同而变化。

inlines.text: 关于这些结果
结果反映的是在特定编码任务和配置下的评测。性能与成本对比会因工作负载、模型配置、推理强度以及定价假设的不同而变化。
MAI Code 2 的性能与价格：
所有模型均以最高推理强度运行。DeepSWE 1.1、TerminalBench 2.1 和 SWE Atlas 在 MSBench（微软内部评测平台）上运行，使用 GitHub Copilot CLI，未启用子智能体。FrontierCode 1.1 的分数和成本来自 Artificial Analysis；MAI-Code-2 的成本按 50% 促销价显示。
视觉编码：
由人工对 MAI Code 2 和 GPT-6 Sol 进行盲测对比，覆盖用户界面、游戏、数据可视化、3D 场景和 SVG 图形。偏好评分同时涵盖美观度和功能性，由共计 258 名标注员完成标注。
MAI Code 2 Flash 的性能与价格：
所有模型均以最高推理强度运行。DeepSWE 1.1、TerminalBench 2.1 和 SWE Atlas 在 MSBench 上运行，使用 GitHub Copilot CLI，未启用子智能体。MAI-Code-2-Flash 的成本按 50% 促销价显示。

blocks.text: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash: two new coding models built for the everyday enterprise coding tasks, delivering leading performance at a fraction of the cost of competing models.

inlines.text: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash: two new coding models built for the everyday enterprise coding tasks, delivering leading performance at a fraction of the cost of competing models.

blocks.text: Performance and speed for everyday coding

inlines.text: Performance and speed for everyday coding

blocks.text: MAI Code 2 is at the frontier of price-performance for common enterprise coding tasks and excels in taking code to production, deep debugging, multi-file implementation, repo wide reasoning, and UI. It does all of this while also delivering changes code maintainers would merge, at a fraction of frontier cost.

inlines.text: MAI Code 2 is at the frontier of price-performance for common enterprise coding tasks and excels in taking code to production, deep debugging, multi-file implementation, repo wide reasoning, and UI. It does all of this while also delivering changes code maintainers would merge, at a fraction of frontier cost.

blocks.text: Meanwhile, MAI Code 2 Flash is designed for high-volume work such as code explanations, targeted edits, routine fixes, and rapid iterations, while bringing quality at a much lower cost.

inlines.text: Meanwhile, MAI Code 2 Flash is designed for high-volume work such as code explanations, targeted edits, routine fixes, and rapid iterations, while bringing quality at a much lower cost.

blocks.text: Production quality at less than half the price

inlines.text: Production quality at less than half the price

blocks.text: To deliver the best price-performance, we’ve built these models to prioritize the coding work our customers do every day. They’re explicitly not yet tuned for harder problems, like fundamental science research and very long horizon agentic work.

inlines.text: To deliver the best price-performance, we’ve built these models to prioritize the coding work our customers do every day. They’re explicitly not yet tuned for harder problems, like fundamental science research and very long horizon agentic work.

blocks.text: Averaged over four widely used benchmarks that target the everyday enterprise coding tasks we see in GitHub Copilot (DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal Bench 2.1, SWE-Atlas and FrontierCode v1.1), MAI Code 2 gives you 98% of the performance of GPT 6.1 Sol at 40% of the cost, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5’s performance at just 5% of the cost.1

blocks.text:
About these results

Results reflect evaluations on specific coding tasks and configurations. Performance and cost comparisons vary by workload, model configuration, reasoning effort, and pricing assumptions.

inlines.text: About these results
Results reflect evaluations on specific coding tasks and configurations. Performance and cost comparisons vary by workload, model configuration, reasoning effort, and pricing assumptions.
MAI Code 2 performance and price:

All models were run at max reasoning effort. DeepSWE 1.1, TerminalBench 2.1 and SWE Atlas were run on MSBench (Microsoft’s internal eval platform) with the GitHub Copilot CLI without subagents. FrontierCode 1.1 scores and costs are from Artificial Analysis; MAI-Code-2 cost is shown at its 50% promotional price.
Visual coding:

Blind human side-by-side evaluations of MAI Code 2 and GPT-6 Sol across user interfaces, games, data visualizations, 3D scenes, and SVG graphics. The preference covers both aesthetics and functionality, and is annotated by a total of 258 annotators.
MAI Code 2 Flash performance and price:

All models were run at max reasoning effort. DeepSWE 1.1, TerminalBench 2.1 and SWE Atlas were run on MSBench with the GitHub Copilot CLI without subagents. MAI-Code-2-Flash cost is shown at its 50% promotional price.
